# MuZe (MeTaBos)

> Open-source (MIT), self-hosted AI business operating system built with Next.js and SQLite. AI agents draft Meta inbox replies, social posts, ad drafts and invoices; every action is logged as a commit, and nothing is sent until a human approves the exact payload (the "Jev" gate). Default AI path is free/local Llama (Ollama llama3.2:3b, WebLLM in the browser, Llama Guard 3 1B). Single-operator preview, not production-ready; Meta channels need the user's own credentials and otherwise show "Not connected". Not affiliated with Meta.
